changelog:
Initial release of the humanizer skill.

- Detects and removes 24 specific patterns common in AI-generated text.
- Identifies 500+ AI vocabulary terms across three tiers for precise filtering.
- Performs statistical analysis (burstiness, type-token ratio, sentence length variation, trigram repetition) to spot AI writing traits.
- Provides rewrite suggestions to make text sound naturally human, with appropriate personality and varied sentence structure.
- Supports analysis, scoring, reporting, and auto-humanization via command-line tools.
- Includes guidelines for integrating the humanizer in always-on agent modes.
